name: forward FS uses the predecessor start instead of its end
find: WHEN 'FS' THEN ef[p] + llag[j]

name: forward SS uses the predecessor end instead of its start
find: WHEN 'SS' THEN es[p] + llag[j]

name: forward FF forgets to subtract the successor duration
find: WHEN 'FF' THEN ef[p] + llag[j] - rem[c]

name: forward SF forgets to subtract the successor duration
find: ELSE           es[p] + llag[j] - rem[c] END;

name: backward FS adds the lag instead of subtracting it
find: WHEN 'FS' THEN ls[t] - llag[j]

name: backward SS forgets the remaining duration of the predecessor
find: WHEN 'SS' THEN ls[t] - llag[j] + rem[c]

name: backward FF bounds by the successor late start instead of its late finish
find: WHEN 'FF' THEN lf[t] - llag[j]

name: backward SF forgets the remaining duration of the predecessor
find: ELSE           lf[t] - llag[j] + rem[c] END;

name: an unknown link_type is not coerced to FS
find: THEN r.link_type ELSE 'FS' END

name: summaries counted in overall / planned
find: WHERE w > 0 AND NOT (x.id = ANY (sumids));

name: a summary can be late and critical on its own
find: IF NOT is_sum[i] AND NOT done[i] AND endd[i] IS NOT NULL
replace: IF NOT done[i] AND endd[i] IS NOT NULL

name: a summary is part of the forecast end
find:
WHERE sched[g.ix] AND NOT is_sum[g.ix];
  v_deadline
reason: a summary is only scheduled when some kid is, and deriveFwd then sets its end to the latest kid end, so it can never exceed the leaves: the forecast is identical

name: summaries not processed deepest first
find: ORDER BY depth[g.ix] DESC, g.ix

name: a summary is never done (all-kids-done rule dropped)
find: done[s] := v_all; sched[s] := v_any;
reason: a done summary only matters as a link endpoint; as successor ls[t] is NULL (no incomplete kid) and is skipped, as predecessor every target leaf is done and skipped: identical output

name: a summary is scheduled even when no kid is
find: done[s] := v_all; sched[s] := v_any;

name: the parent column is ignored (no hierarchy at all)
find: IF k IS NOT NULL AND k <> i THEN par[i] := k; END IF;
replace: IF FALSE THEN par[i] := k; END IF;

name: undated link participants no longer scheduled (Phase A rule)
find: IF NOT (done[t] AND endd[t] IS NULL) THEN sched[t] := true; END IF;

name: m1: the end date is not clamped
find: LEAST(GREATEST(r.end_date,   DATE '2000-01-01'), DATE '2100-12-31')

name: m1: the start date is not clamped
find: LEAST(GREATEST(r.start_date, DATE '2000-01-01'), DATE '2100-12-31')

name: m1: the clamp has no lower bound (start)
find: LEAST(GREATEST(r.start_date, DATE '2000-01-01'), DATE '2100-12-31')

name: m1: the clamp has no upper bound (end)
find: LEAST(GREATEST(r.end_date,   DATE '2000-01-01'), DATE '2100-12-31')

name: parent cycle cut at the wrong edge
find: IF stamp[nx] = i THEN par[k] := 0; EXIT; END IF;
replace: IF stamp[nx] = i THEN par[i] := 0; EXIT; END IF;

replace: ne := ne + 1; esrc[ne] := n + par[i]; edst[ne] := par[i];

replace: ne := ne + 1; esrc[ne] := n + par[i]; edst[ne] := par[i];

name: r3 sweep: a summary constraint is not inherited by nested kids (forward)
find: IF effo[par[s]] IS NOT NULL AND (effo[s] IS NULL OR effo[par[s]] > effo[s]) THEN

find: effo[par[s]] > effo[s]) THEN

name: r3 sweep: a summary constraint takes the larger value (backward)
find: effb[par[s]] < effb[s]) THEN

name: r3 sweep: a leaf ignores the constraint of its summary (forward)
find: IF effo[par[v]] > es[v] THEN

name: r3 sweep: a leaf ignores the constraint of its summary (backward)
find: IF effb[par[v]] < lf[v] THEN

name: r3 sweep: several links into one summary keep the smaller (forward)
find: IF ownf[t] IS NULL OR cand > ownf[t] THEN
replace: IF ownf[t] IS NULL OR cand < ownf[t] THEN

name: r3 sweep: several links from one summary keep the larger (backward)
find: IF ownb[p] IS NULL OR cand < ownb[p] THEN
replace: IF ownb[p] IS NULL OR cand > ownb[p] THEN

name: r3 sweep: a link into a done leaf is applied
find: ELSIF NOT done[t] AND cand > es[t] THEN

name: r3 pass loop: pruning skips a larger constraint (forward)
find: cand <= fapp[t] THEN CONTINUE;

name: r3 pass loop: pruning skips a smaller constraint (backward)
find: cand >= bapp[p] THEN CONTINUE;

name: r3 pass loop: pruning removed (forward)
find: IF is_sum[t] AND fapp[t] IS NOT NULL AND cand <= fapp[t] THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
reason: performance only: when cand <= fapp[t] every leaf of t already starts at or after cand, so the leaf loop changes nothing; output is identical, only the work differs (bench-summary-links.sh cyclic variant)

name: r3 pass loop: pruning removed (backward)
find: IF is_sum[p] AND bapp[p] IS NOT NULL AND cand >= bapp[p] THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
reason: performance only, same argument as the forward pruning (bench-summary-links.sh cyclic variant)

name: r3 pass loop: leaves after p keep the value from before p was raised (forward)
find: cand1 := cand + CASE ty WHEN 'FS' THEN ef[p] - f0 ELSE es[p] - e0 END;

name: r3 pass loop: leaves after t keep the value from before t was lowered (backward)
find: cand1 := cand + CASE ty WHEN 'FS' THEN ls[t] - e0 ELSE lf[t] - f0 END;

name: r3 pass loop: the leaf p itself also sees the raised value (forward)
find: candc := CASE WHEN c > p THEN cand1 ELSE cand END;
replace: candc := CASE WHEN c >= p THEN cand1 ELSE cand END;

name: r3 pass loop: the leaf t itself also sees the lowered value (backward)
find: candc := CASE WHEN c > t THEN cand1 ELSE cand END;
replace: candc := CASE WHEN c >= t THEN cand1 ELSE cand END;

name: r3 pass loop: a done leaf p is raised by a link into its own summary
find: AND NOT done[p] AND cand > es[p] THEN

name: r3 hierarchy: depth not tracked (summaries not deepest first)
find: depth[c] := depth[k] + 1;

name: r3 hierarchy: the leaf range of a summary ends one leaf early
find: hi[k] := nl; sp := sp - 1;

name: r3 hierarchy: the parent-cycle shortcut stops at unproven chains
find: IF okp[nx] THEN EXIT; END IF;
replace: IF okp[nx] THEN par[k] := 0; EXIT; END IF;

name: r3 hierarchy: parent-cycle shortcut removed
find: IF okp[nx] THEN EXIT; END IF;
reason: performance only: walking on from a chain already proven to reach a root finds no cycle (it cannot contain a node of the current walk), so the cut set is identical; covered by the deep-nesting timing in bench-summary-links.sh
